newDiffFindings.evidence: The proposed reporter subscribes to child_process and emits its sole ready at module load. Its async generator emits end then unsubscribes in finally when the first TestsStream finishes. Reusing the fixed ESM instance for the four later public run() calls will not observe their native child lifecycle, while each consumption would emit a separate end. The parser requires exactly one ready/end and the outcome matcher rejects further result events after the first cumulative summary. These invariants suit one original aggregate stream and cannot consume five sequential genuine streams as proposed.
newDiffFindings.fix: Give the fixed programmatic CLI a supported observation session through all five admission and retirement cycles, with explicit run/file framing and independent expected original summaries. Keep one composed terminal boundary at the session level, distinguish it from the five Node summaries, and keep lifecycle observation installed until every acquired child closes. Verify that each run is separately admitted before publication. Keep the six-group plan and existing process/clocks unchanged.
